summary: Make a new episode in a proven video style - Collage Explainer, Finance Explainer, Animated Science Explainer, 3D Brand Explainer, 3D True Crime - on the person's topic. Use for "an episode of", "in the style of", "sample this style", 「用这个风格做一集」.
whenToUse: Use for "an episode of", "in the style of", "sample this style", 「用这个风格做一集」.
verification: One heavy job at a time (renders, long ffmpeg, transcription): renders with --workers 1, ffmpeg with -threads 2 -nostdin. For a change, render only that window.

Run REMIX.md's checks. Report each of our numbers beside the series' own: cuts a minute, pause density, longest hold, loudness, sound effects on picture changes, the script fingerprint. Name every check that failed.
Stop 2: ask once on the draft: a contact sheet and npx hyperframes preview --background --no-open (add --port <free port> when 3002 is taken), with what is still a stand-in.
